data.reason: Independent manual content review of this standalone artifact against every retained original requirement.
data.rationale: The synthetic -1/+1/0 contract distinguishes unknown from negative, excludes target columns and explicitly restricts fit to known labels. The independent contract changes 0 to normal and -1 to unknown, requiring the student to re-read rather than assume label meanings. The lesson states its known-label-only model does not solve full Antique and warns about LabelPropagation remapping. The retained PU constant-alpha observation-assumptions contrast is still not taught or independently assessed.
